name: 3d-flight-tracker
description: Live aircraft on an interactive 3D globe, backed by OpenSky state vectors.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @flight/server" "npm run dev -w @flight/client"
scripts.dev:live: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:live -w @flight/server" "npm run dev -w @flight/client"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @flight/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
